description.en: Full-system x86 and x86-64 PC emulator supporting i386 through Core i7 CPUs, Bochs VBE SVGA, Cirrus CL-GD5446, Voodoo Banshee, ATA disks and CD-ROM, dual floppies, Sound Blaster 16, ES1370 audio, USB HID, SLIRP networking, on-screen PC keyboard, and checkpoints.
description.tr: i386'dan Core i7'ye kadar işlemci, Bochs VBE SVGA, Cirrus CL-GD5446, Voodoo Banshee, ATA sabit disk ve CD-ROM, çift disket, Sound Blaster 16, ES1370 ses, USB HID, SLIRP ağ, ekran PC klavyesi ve durum kaydı sunan tam x86 / x86-64 PC emülatörü.
